01 / THE SHORT VERSION OF OUR STORYABOUT US ↙

Still have homework.
Still have things to share.

Not teachers
with all the answers.
Students, like you.

The Tins isn’t a big coaching centre. It’s Vedant Kumar, Zeenat Khan and Amritansh Dubey, sharing different things we know while we’re still figuring out plenty ourselves.

We study at Delhi’s CM SHRI schools, formerly Excellence / ASOSE. School is part of our story, but this is our own student-led project. Three people, three ways to help. Each of us has three years of experience in what we teach. That’s where we’re starting.

Meet the three of us ↗
A SMALL BEGINNING, IN THREE PARTS

no grand origin story. just us.

01 — THE COMMON GROUND

Before anything else,
we’re students.

High school students, to be specific. Our Class 9 marks were 87%, 90% and 87%. Those numbers are part of the picture. They don’t make us experts at everything.

What we do bring is the perspective of someone who’s still on your side of the classroom.

same side of the desk ↘
02 — THREE DIFFERENT STRENGTHS

We don’t all teach
the same thing.

Vedant Kumar handles coding and embedded engineering. Amritansh Dubey focuses on real-world skills. Zeenat Khan offers online tuition.

Two offline paths, one online path. You can come for the thing you need, rather than fit into one big programme.

different things to share ↗
03 — WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Something small.
Something of our own.

That’s The Tins. Not a promise to change your life overnight. A way to learn with students who have something useful to share.

We’re at the beginning. If you have a question, we’d rather hear it than pretend we’ve already answered everything.

Ask us something ↗
